definitions.explanation: A counter for number of times or frequency of events. Used to count how many times something happens or has happened.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いち}{日|にち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{回|かい}⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the medicine three times a day.
How many times have you been to Japan?

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{回|かい}⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please say it one more time.
examples.notes: Note: いっかい with small っ

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}{週|しゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{回|かい}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I've already seen two movies this week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{回|かい}⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We became friends even though we only met once.

notes:
{回|かい} is the standard counter for occurrences, repetitions, or frequency.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{回|かい}: once (note: ⟦いっ→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧い with small っ)
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{回|かい}: twice
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{回|かい}: three times
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：03100_nan⟧{回|かい}: how many times?

PRONUNCIATION:
⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{回|かい} uses gemination (small っ). It is NOT read いちかい.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{回|かい}: one more time
- ⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧: every time
- ⟦{初回|しょかい}→初回：11780_shokai⟧: first time/round
- ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧: this time
- ⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧: next time

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to show frequency: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{回|かい} (three times a week).
